name: MSCR Youth Aquatics Assistant Swim Instructor
org: Madison School & Community Recreation (MSCR), Madison Metropolitan School District
what_you_do: A part-time job helping lead instructors teach Red Cross Learn-to-Swim classes at Madison school pools. You keep lessons fun and can learn to plan and co-teach classes.
who_can_apply: At least 15 years old by the start date. You must swim 25 yards of all six strokes to a Level 4 standard (or be willing to learn) and be comfortable in deep water up to 12 feet.
duration: Up to 18.5 hours a week, evenings and weekends; the current posting started Sept 13, 2026
deadline_text: Posted on the MSCR jobs page for the 2026-27 school year with no closing date. Apply while the posting is up.
how_to_apply: Click APPLY next to the job on the MSCR jobs page and fill out the online application. MSCR only takes online applications. Questions: Michelle Borkovec, mborkovec@madison.k12.wi.us.
notes: You work at Goodman Pool, La Follette, Lapham or West High. MSCR can help you get your lifeguard card or swim teacher card. The MSCR lifeguard job pays $19 an hour, but you need your lifeguard, CPR and first aid cards first. In Wisconsin, workers under 16 need a work permit. Job site help: (608) 204-3057.
